description: Recommend a set of publications for a goal, audience and budget — already quoted, total inside budget including the 3.5% processing fee. Use this when a buyer says what they want to achieve and what they can spend, rather than naming publications. A backlink or SEO goal leaves out nofollow links. The shareUrl opens the store with the planned placements in the cart (none when a niche price applies); the plan recommends, it reserves nothing.

budget.description: Maximum spend in USD, including the processing fee.

count.description: How many placements to aim for. Default 5.

goal.description: What the coverage is for, e.g. "seo backlinks", "launch buzz".

minMonthlyTraffic.description: Minimum estimated monthly visits to the outlet's site.

niche.description: The restricted subject the article is on, if any: CBD, Crypto, Health, Gambling or Erotic. Priced at the outlet's price for that niche, and refused where the outlet doesn't accept it.

name: plan_placements
title: Plan placements
